metadata.title: Fetch Work Item Details
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Fetch work item details from Azure DevOps via MCP tool and extract key fields (title, description, acceptance criteria, detailed solution, relations) for downstream planning or test generation steps.

output.description: Work item details extracted and stored in memory

prerequisites: workItemId parameter available from process parameters
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: call ADO MCP tool → extract fields → store in memory → compliance check
Use mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item with project='Payoneer', id=workItemId, expand='all'
If the MCP call fails, report the error clearly and stop — do NOT proceed with missing work item data
Extract all fields listed in memoryUpdates even if some are empty/null
tools: mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item - Fetch work item details from Azure DevOps
bestPractices: Always use expand='all' to get relations and all fields in a single call
Preserve HTML formatting in Description and Acceptance Criteria fields for downstream consumers
Store the raw work item response alongside extracted fields for reference
Log the work item title immediately after fetch for traceability
If Custom.DetailedSolution is empty, note this explicitly — do not silently skip it

substeps.name: Call wit_work_item MCP tool
substeps.description: Fetch the work item from Azure DevOps using the MCP tool
actions: Read workItemId from process parameters
Call mcp__azuredevops__wit_work_item with project='Payoneer', id=workItemId, expand='all'
If the call fails: report the error message clearly and STOP — do not proceed
If the call succeeds: proceed to extraction

substeps.name: Extract key fields
substeps.description: Extract all relevant fields from the work item response
actions: Extract Title from fields.System.Title
Extract Description from fields.System.Description
Extract Acceptance Criteria from fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria
Extract Custom.DetailedSolution from fields.Custom.DetailedSolution
Extract Relations array from relations
Extract AreaPath from fields.System.AreaPath
Extract IterationPath from fields.System.IterationPath
Extract AssignedTo from fields.System.AssignedTo
Extract State from fields.System.State
Note any fields that are empty or null

substeps.name: Store extracted data in memory
substeps.description: Write all extracted work item fields to memory.json
actions: Write workItem object to current step's informationProduced section in memory
Include all extracted fields: id, title, description, acceptanceCriteria, detailedSolution, relations, areaPath, iterationPath, assignedTo, state
Note which fields were empty/null under Notes

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: All key fields were extracted (even if null)
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: Call ADO MCP tool to fetch work item -> Extract key fields from response -> Store in memory -> Compliance check. If MCP call fails at substep 0, the step halts with an error.

fields: Information Produced: workItem object with id, title, description, acceptanceCriteria, detailedSolution, relations, areaPath, iterationPath, assignedTo, state
Notes: Fields that were empty/null, any warnings from ADO response
